name: Baku City Circuit
summary: Old city walls, a 2 km flat-out run along the seafront and a corner barely wider than a car.
character: Two tracks in one: a tight, walled section through the old city, then a full-throttle run down Neftchilar Avenue where the slipstream makes passing easy. Safety cars are almost guaranteed.

layouts.name: Current layout
factNotes: Length: 6.003 km per f1-circuits.com, Sportmonks and Formula One History; PlanetF1 has 6.006 km.

corners.name: Castle section (Turn 8)
corners.note: Uphill past the old city walls and about 7.6 m wide. Two cars don't fit. People still try.

corners.name: Neftchilar Avenue
corners.note: The long flat-out run to the line. The leader gets towed along and whoever's chasing gets a chance.

moments.title: Vettel hits Hamilton behind the safety car
moments.body: Sebastian Vettel thought Lewis Hamilton had brake-tested him and drove into the side of his car. Vettel got a stop-go penalty, Hamilton had to pit for a loose headrest, and Daniel Ricciardo won from 10th on the grid.

history.body: First race, called the European Grand Prix.
